items.Sentence: The current treatment system consists of influent screening, grit removal, an anoxic reactor for flow/load equalization and a carbon source for denitrification, sequencing batch reactors (SBR’s) for biological treatment including nitrification and denitrification, cloth media filtration, automated chemical feed, pre- and post-filtration turbidity instrumentation, and an ultraviolet light (UV) disinfection system.
